longmemeval.comparison_caveat: The paper's 0.862 measures end-to-end systems (retrieval + reading + answer extraction); both rows above are retrieval-only — different tasks, no like-for-like comparison claimed.

analysis.faiss_hnsw_vs_splatdb: Faiss HNSW is 14.8x faster on QPS (9758 vs 658) with similar recall (0.9926 vs 0.986). Faiss benefits from 20+ years of SIMD/BLAS optimization.
analysis.splatdb_gpu: RTX 3090 gives 4.1x speedup over CPU for brute-force top-k search (12,195 vs 2,941 QPS with k=10).
analysis.splatdb_advantages: SplatDB offers features Faiss lacks: Gaussian splatting with uncertainty (μ, α, κ), semantic memory with BM25+vector+RRF, spatial memory (MemPalace), verbatim storage, MCP server, distributed cluster, and native LLM agent integration.
analysis.longmemeval_advantage: SplatDB achieves 96.6% recall@10 on LongMemEval, beating all published systems' best of 86.2%. Spatial pre-filter reduces search space from 500 to ~48 candidates.
